scope: A truth-aware, post-open representation-capacity diagnostic using all 1,010 fields from ten already opened PoolFire training trajectories and the four already opened v177 evaluation frames. It evaluates the frozen five-camera sensor and an all-nine sensor control before and after one unchanged CGLS step.
question: Does v177 fail because the opened PoolFire training family lacks a linear field representation capable of matching the four evaluation fields, or because the useful representation cannot yet be selected from deployment-visible observations?

sensors: frozen geometry-selected five-camera sensor from v176
arms: truth-aware affine projection followed by unchanged CGLS K1
static fit mean followed by unchanged CGLS K1

preserved_initial_inconclusive.cause: The first validator compared physical source times against normalized time labels.
preserved_initial_inconclusive.repair_scope: Validation-only normalization check; no scientific arm, threshold, metric, formal array, or decision rule changed.

interpretation: The stable affine span of the 1,010 opened PoolFire training fields contains a truth-aware witness that passes every frozen five-camera and all-nine field, gradient, and observation gate before and after one unchanged CGLS step. The static fit mean fails, so the result is not a fixed-prior effect. This removes missing linear field-span capacity as the explanation for v177.
limitation: The stable affine rank is 1,009 out of 1,010 fields, so the positive witness is almost full sample rank. The experiment does not show a compact latent representation or that deployment-visible observations can predict the affine coordinates.
route_action: Freeze a separate minimal observation-and-geometry-only predictability diagnostic for the affine coordinates, with complete-trajectory isolation and cheap deterministic controls. Do not train a neural model, rent a GPU, open untouched tests, or claim resource savings from v178 alone.
